== Overview ==

'''SecureConnectionProtocol''' is used by clients when joining a the games secure server to create the secure connection and register themselves with the game server. This protocol also contains some miscellaneous helper methods for matchmaking.

|}

=== Register ===

Registers the client with the game server insecurely. Clients should never use this method unless [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/TicketGrantingProtocol#LoginEx|TicketGrantingProtocol#LoginEx]] was used when connecting to the authentication server.

The client sends the server it's current list of stations (should usually only contain the clients local station), and the server returns the clients public station.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]]&gt; || vecMyURLs || Client's current station list
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#Result|Result]] || %retval% || Registration result
|-
| UInt32 || pidConnectionID || The client's station <code>RVCID</code> value
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]] || urlPublic || Client's public station
|}

=== RequestConnectionData ===

Requests connection data for a specific user. Seems to be only usable if already in a session with the target.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || cidTarget || The target's connection ID
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || pidTarget || The target's [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]]
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Result of the request
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#ConnectionData]]&gt; || pvecConnectionsData || List of the target's stations. Empty if <code>%retval%</code> is false
|}

=== RequestUrls ===

Requests a specific user's station list. Seems to be only usable if already in a session with the target.

Replaced with [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol|MatchMakingProtocol#GetSessionURLs]] after NEX 1.

Unclear how this effectively differs from [[#RequestConnectionData]].

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || cidTarget || The target's connection ID
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || pidTarget || The target's [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]]
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| Boolean || %retval% || Result of the request
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]]&gt; || plstURLs || List of the target's stations. Empty if <code>%retval%</code> is false
|}

=== RegisterEx ===

Registers the client with the game server securely. Clients may use this method whether or not [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/TicketGrantingProtocol#LoginEx|TicketGrantingProtocol#LoginEx]] was used when connecting to the authentication server.

The client sends the server it's current list of stations (should usually only contain the clients local station), and the server returns the clients public station.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]]&gt; || vecMyURLs || Client's current station list
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#DataHolder|DataHolder]] || hCustomData || Login data. In NEX this is either [[#NintendoLoginData]] or [[#AccountExtraInfo]]
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#Result|Result]] || %retval% || Registration result
|-
| UInt32 || pidConnectionID || The client's station <code>RVCID</code> value
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]] || urlPublic || Client's public station
|}

=== TestConnectivity ===

Checks if the client can reach to the game server.

==== Request ====

This method does not take any parameters.

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== UpdateURLs ===

Updates the clients station list to the provided list.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]]&gt; || vecMyURLs || New station list
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== ReplaceURL ===

Replaces only a specific station in the clients list with another. Only check the address/port to determine a match.

If the new station is missing <code>RVCID</code> or <code>PID</code>, it is added in this method.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]] || target || The station to replace
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#StationURL|StationURL]] || url || New station
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== SendReport ===

Sends an arbitrary "report" to the server. Report data can be anything.

Notably, games which use [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/PIA|PIA]] use this method to send [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/PIA/Protocols/MonitoringData|MonitoringData]] reports after matches.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || reportId || Report "ID". This does not appear to be unique per report, so it is likely something such as a "report category"?
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#qBuffer|qBuffer]] || reportData || Report data
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.
